title: 大潭電廠燃氣複循環機組
subcategoryTitleEn: Power cycles and combined heat and power
summary: 桃園觀音的大潭電廠是臺灣裝置容量最大的燃氣電廠，原有六部複循環機組約 438 萬瓩，之後陸續增建更高效率的新機組。它的天然氣全部來自進口的液化天然氣。2017 年 8 月 15 日，供氣管線的閥門被誤關了兩分鐘，六部機組全部跳脫，全臺數百萬戶輪流停電。課程定量分析這次事故損失的出力占比、電廠每天的用氣量與船期、儲槽的安全存量，以及夏季高溫對燃氣渦輪機出力的影響。
summaryEn: Datan at Guanyin in Taoyuan is Taiwan's largest gas-fired plant by capacity, with six original combined-cycle units of about 4,380 MW and newer, more efficient units added since. All its gas is imported liquefied natural gas. On 15 August 2017 a valve on the supply line was closed by mistake for two minutes, all six units tripped and millions of households across Taiwan had rotating power cuts. The course quantifies the share of output lost in that event, daily gas use and shipping interval, safety stock in tanks, and the effect of summer heat on gas turbine output.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與標準架構編寫的原創教學。步驟是可驗證的分析、估算與檢核任務，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、運轉程序或作業許可。核能內容僅限公開的熱循環、功能架構、土木與安全理念，不包含燃料製備、濃縮、再處理、武器、反應度整定、反應爐操作或保安細節。數值為公開標稱值或教學假設，實際工程須由合格專業人員依規範與實測資料重新計算並負責。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and standards frameworks. Steps are verifiable analysis, estimation and checking tasks, not drawings, method statements, operating procedures or permits. Nuclear content is limited to public thermal cycles, functional architecture, civil works and safety concepts and excludes fuel production, enrichment, reprocessing, weapons, reactivity settings, reactor operation and security details. Numbers are public nominal values or teaching assumptions; real work must be recalculated by qualified professionals using codes and measured data.

nodes: Generator and power or heat network

v30Focus: 臺灣最大的燃氣電廠：單一供氣點的風險、液化天然氣的船期與存量、夏季高溫對出力的影響
v30FocusEn: Taiwan's largest gas-fired plant: the risk of a single gas supply point, LNG shipping and stocks, and the effect of summer heat on output

stages.title: 資源、需求與系統架構：大潭電廠燃氣複循環機組
stages.titleEn: Resource, demand and system architecture: Datan Gas-Fired Combined-Cycle Power Plant
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「複循環的合成效率」與「壓力比與布雷頓循環」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Combined-cycle efficiency" and "Pressure ratio and the Brayton cycle": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

quiz.question: 關於「複循環的合成效率」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Combined-cycle efficiency" is correct?
options: 燃氣渦輪排出約 600 °C 的廢氣仍含有大量的熱。
複循環的效率就是燃氣渦輪效率加上汽輪機效率。
燃氣渦輪的壓力比越高越好，沒有上限。
optionsEn: Gas-turbine exhaust at about 600 °C still carries a great deal of heat.
Combined-cycle efficiency is simply gas-turbine efficiency plus steam-turbine efficiency.
The higher the pressure ratio of a gas turbine the better, with no limit.
quiz.explanation: 燃氣渦輪排出約 600 °C 的廢氣仍含有大量的熱。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Gas-turbine exhaust at about 600 °C still carries a great deal of heat. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 複循環的合成效率：機制與能量路徑
steps.titleEn: Combined-cycle efficiency: mechanism and energy path
steps.objective: 說明「複循環的合成效率」如何決定「大潭電廠燃氣複循環機組」的能量轉換、輸送、儲存或安全功能，並畫出輸入、轉換、損失與系統邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Combined-cycle efficiency” governs energy conversion, transfer, storage or safety functions in “Datan Gas-Fired Combined-Cycle Power Plant”, and map inputs, conversions, losses and the system boundary.
steps.instruction: 燃氣渦輪排出約 600 °C 的廢氣仍含有大量的熱。複循環電廠用熱回收鍋爐（HRSG）以這些廢熱產生蒸汽，再推動汽輪機多發約一半的電。兩個循環串接後，整體效率等於燃氣渦輪的效率，加上「未轉成功的熱」被蒸汽循環再利用的部分；最先進的 H 級與 J 級機組淨效率已超過 60%，是目前效率最高的大型火力發電方式。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Gas-turbine exhaust at about 600 °C still carries a great deal of heat. A combined-cycle plant raises steam from it in a heat recovery steam generator and drives a steam turbine for roughly half as much power again. With the two cycles in series, overall efficiency is gas-turbine efficiency plus the part of the remaining heat that the steam cycle recovers; the most advanced H- and J-class units exceed 60% net, the highest of any large thermal generation. Mentor task: draw the energy and material flow of this unit (inputs, conversions, losses, outputs, boundary), mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by resource, environment or operation, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 工程檔案：原有 6 部複循環機組，裝置容量合計約 438 萬 kW
steps.observationEn: Project file: The 6 original combined-cycle units total about 4,380 MW
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「複循環的效率就是燃氣渦輪效率加上汽輪機效率。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在流程圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Combined-cycle efficiency is simply gas-turbine efficiency plus steam-turbine efficiency." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your flow diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 流程圖標明「複循環的合成效率」的輸入、轉換、損失與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The flow diagram shows inputs, conversions, losses and boundary for “Combined-cycle efficiency”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 複循環的合成效率
knowledge.text: 燃氣渦輪排出約 600 °C 的廢氣仍含有大量的熱。複循環電廠用熱回收鍋爐（HRSG）以這些廢熱產生蒸汽，再推動汽輪機多發約一半的電。兩個循環串接後，整體效率等於燃氣渦輪的效率，加上「未轉成功的熱」被蒸汽循環再利用的部分；最先進的 H 級與 J 級機組淨效率已超過 60%，是目前效率最高的大型火力發電方式。
knowledge.textEn: Gas-turbine exhaust at about 600 °C still carries a great deal of heat. A combined-cycle plant raises steam from it in a heat recovery steam generator and drives a steam turbine for roughly half as much power again. With the two cycles in series, overall efficiency is gas-turbine efficiency plus the part of the remaining heat that the steam cycle recovers; the most advanced H- and J-class units exceed 60% net, the highest of any large thermal generation.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：複循環的效率就是燃氣渦輪效率加上汽輪機效率。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Combined-cycle efficiency is simply gas-turbine efficiency plus steam-turbine efficiency. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

knowledge.title: 工程檔案
knowledge.text: 原有 6 部複循環機組，裝置容量合計約 438 萬 kW
knowledge.textEn: The 6 original combined-cycle units total about 4,380 MW

quiz.question: 依「複循環的合成效率」的模型 η_cc = η_gt + (1−η_gt)·η_hrsg·η_st，由三個分項效率合成的複循環毛效率（代表值）最接近下列何者？
quiz.questionEn: Using the model η_cc = η_gt + (1−η_gt)·η_hrsg·η_st for "Combined-cycle efficiency", which value is closest to the gross combined-cycle efficiency from three component efficiencies (representative)?
quiz.explanation: η_cc = η_gt + (1−η_gt)·η_hrsg·η_st；代入 etag = 0.41、etah = 0.88、etas = 0.39，得 61.2 %（由三個分項效率合成的複循環毛效率（代表值））。 其餘選項是倍數或數量級錯誤。
quiz.explanationEn: η_cc = η_gt + (1−η_gt)·η_hrsg·η_st; with etag = 0.41, etah = 0.88, etas = 0.39 the result is 61.2 % (gross combined-cycle efficiency from three component efficiencies (representative)). The other options are factor or order-of-magnitude errors.

steps.title: 複循環的合成效率：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Combined-cycle efficiency: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「複循環的合成效率」的關鍵量，並判斷輸入改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “Combined-cycle efficiency” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：η_cc = η_gt + (1−η_gt)·η_hrsg·η_st；代入 etag = 0.41、etah = 0.88、etas = 0.39，得 61.2 %（由三個分項效率合成的複循環毛效率（代表值））。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 etag 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: η_cc = η_gt + (1−η_gt)·η_hrsg·η_st; with etag = 0.41, etah = 0.88, etas = 0.39 the result is 61.2 % (gross combined-cycle efficiency from three component efficiencies (representative)). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise etag by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：etag 增加 10% 時，結果變為 63.9 %（+4.4%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising etag by 10% changes the result to 63.9 % (+4.4%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 61.2 %（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 etag 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 61.2 % (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in etag with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: η_cc = η_gt + (1−η_gt)·η_hrsg·η_st；代入 etag = 0.41、etah = 0.88、etas = 0.39，得 61.2 %（由三個分項效率合成的複循環毛效率（代表值））。
knowledge.textEn: η_cc = η_gt + (1−η_gt)·η_hrsg·η_st; with etag = 0.41, etah = 0.88, etas = 0.39 the result is 61.2 % (gross combined-cycle efficiency from three component efficiencies (representative)).

knowledge.title: 敏感度
knowledge.text: etag 增加 10% 時，結果變為 63.9 %（+4.4%）。 先預測方向與次方，再用計算確認。
knowledge.textEn: Raising etag by 10% changes the result to 63.9 % (+4.4%). Predict direction and exponent first, then confirm by calculation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為公開標稱值或教學假設的簡化；套用到實際設備前，必須依規範、製造商資料與現場量測重新計算。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are public nominal values or simplified teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, recalculate with codes, manufacturer data and site measurements.

quiz.question: 要驗證「複循環的合成效率」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
options: 量測時不必記錄環境溫度、負載與運轉模式，因為它們不影響結果。
燃氣電廠燒的是天然氣，所以沒有碳排放。
分別量測燃氣渦輪出力、汽輪機出力、燃料輸入與熱回收鍋爐的煙氣進出口溫度，求各分項效率，檢查合成值與實測整廠效率是否吻合。
optionsEn: Ambient temperature, load and operating mode need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A gas plant burns natural gas, so it has no carbon emissions.

Measure gas-turbine output, steam-turbine output, fuel input and flue-gas temperature in and out of the HRSG separately, derive each component efficiency, and check that the combination matches measured plant efficiency.
quiz.explanation: 分別量測燃氣渦輪出力、汽輪機出力、燃料輸入與熱回收鍋爐的煙氣進出口溫度，求各分項效率，檢查合成值與實測整廠效率是否吻合。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure gas-turbine output, steam-turbine output, fuel input and flue-gas temperature in and out of the HRSG separately, derive each component efficiency, and check that the combination matches measured plant efficiency. Verification needs a baseline, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 複循環的合成效率：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Combined-cycle efficiency: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「複循環的合成效率」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停留點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Combined-cycle efficiency” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 分別量測燃氣渦輪出力、汽輪機出力、燃料輸入與熱回收鍋爐的煙氣進出口溫度，求各分項效率，檢查合成值與實測整廠效率是否吻合。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器、基準或校正、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停留點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure gas-turbine output, steam-turbine output, fuel input and flue-gas temperature in and out of the HRSG separately, derive each component efficiency, and check that the combination matches measured plant efficiency. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments, baseline or calibration, procedure, comparison, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：調度合約要以分段負載的效率曲線與啟動成本計價，而不是只用滿載效率；熱疲勞壽命消耗須按啟動類型（冷、溫、熱）累計。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Dispatch contracts should price by part-load efficiency curve and start cost rather than full-load efficiency alone, and thermal-fatigue life must be counted by start type, cold, warm or hot.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：部分負載時燃氣渦輪排氣溫度與流量改變，蒸汽循環偏離設計點，整廠效率明顯下降；頻繁起停又使厚壁集管與汽包承受熱疲勞。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境與運轉條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: At part load gas-turbine exhaust temperature and flow change, the steam cycle leaves its design point and plant efficiency falls noticeably, while frequent starts fatigue thick headers and drums thermally. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停留點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, baseline, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 分別量測燃氣渦輪出力、汽輪機出力、燃料輸入與熱回收鍋爐的煙氣進出口溫度，求各分項效率，檢查合成值與實測整廠效率是否吻合。
knowledge.textEn: Measure gas-turbine output, steam-turbine output, fuel input and flue-gas temperature in and out of the HRSG separately, derive each component efficiency, and check that the combination matches measured plant efficiency.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 調度合約要以分段負載的效率曲線與啟動成本計價，而不是只用滿載效率；熱疲勞壽命消耗須按啟動類型（冷、溫、熱）累計。
knowledge.textEn: Dispatch contracts should price by part-load efficiency curve and start cost rather than full-load efficiency alone, and thermal-fatigue life must be counted by start type, cold, warm or hot.

knowledge.title: 規範與標準
knowledge.text: 可對照的公開規範或指引：ASME PTC 46 電廠整體性能試驗。引用時須確認版次與適用範圍。
knowledge.textEn: A public code or guide to compare against: ASME PTC 46 Overall Plant Performance. Confirm edition and applicability before citing it.

quiz.question: 在「複循環的合成效率」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Combined-cycle efficiency" shows an anomaly, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 部分負載時燃氣渦輪排氣溫度與流量改變，蒸汽循環偏離設計點，整廠效率明顯下降；頻繁起停又使厚壁集管與汽包承受熱疲勞。
所有異常都是操作人員失誤，設計、製造與維護不需要檢討。
燃氣渦輪的壓力比越高越好，沒有上限。
optionsEn: At part load gas-turbine exhaust temperature and flow change, the steam cycle leaves its design point and plant efficiency falls noticeably, while frequent starts fatigue thick headers and drums thermally.
Every anomaly is operator error, so design, manufacturing and maintenance never need review.
The higher the pressure ratio of a gas turbine the better, with no limit.
quiz.explanation: 部分負載時燃氣渦輪排氣溫度與流量改變，蒸汽循環偏離設計點，整廠效率明顯下降；頻繁起停又使厚壁集管與汽包承受熱疲勞。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: At part load gas-turbine exhaust temperature and flow change, the steam cycle leaves its design point and plant efficiency falls noticeably, while frequent starts fatigue thick headers and drums thermally. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 複循環的合成效率：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Combined-cycle efficiency: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「複循環的合成效率」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or degradation causes of “Combined-cycle efficiency” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 部分負載時燃氣渦輪排氣溫度與流量改變，蒸汽循環偏離設計點，整廠效率明顯下降；頻繁起停又使厚壁集管與汽包承受熱疲勞。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢查，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響「大潭電廠燃氣複循環機組」的安全、出力、壽命或併網。
steps.instructionEn: At part load gas-turbine exhaust temperature and flow change, the steam cycle leaves its design point and plant efficiency falls noticeably, while frequent starts fatigue thick headers and drums thermally. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects safety, output, life or grid connection of “Datan Gas-Fired Combined-Cycle Power Plant”.
steps.observation: 連結機制：兩個循環串接後，整體效率等於燃氣渦輪的效率，加上「未轉成功的熱」被蒸汽循環再利用的部分；最先進的 H 級與 J 級機組淨效率已超過 60%，是目前效率最高的大型火力發電方式。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: With the two cycles in series, overall efficiency is gas-turbine efficiency plus the part of the remaining heat that the steam cycle recovers; the most advanced H- and J-class units exceed 60% net, the highest of any large thermal generation.

steps.title: 壓力比與布雷頓循環：機制與能量路徑
steps.titleEn: Pressure ratio and the Brayton cycle: mechanism and energy path
steps.objective: 說明「壓力比與布雷頓循環」如何決定「大潭電廠燃氣複循環機組」的能量轉換、輸送、儲存或安全功能，並畫出輸入、轉換、損失與系統邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Pressure ratio and the Brayton cycle” governs energy conversion, transfer, storage or safety functions in “Datan Gas-Fired Combined-Cycle Power Plant”, and map inputs, conversions, losses and the system boundary.
steps.instruction: 燃氣渦輪的理想循環由等熵壓縮、等壓加熱、等熵膨脹與等壓排熱組成。理想簡單循環的效率只取決於壓力比：壓力比越高，效率越高；但實際上壓縮機與渦輪都有損失，在給定的渦輪進口溫度下存在最佳壓力比。用於複循環的機組還要讓排氣溫度維持在約 600 °C 以上，下游的蒸汽循環才有足夠高品位的熱可用，因此壓力比通常選在 20 上下，而非追求最高的簡單循環效率。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The ideal gas-turbine cycle is isentropic compression, constant-pressure heat addition, isentropic expansion and constant-pressure heat rejection. Ideal simple-cycle efficiency depends only on pressure ratio and rises with it, but with real compressor and turbine losses there is an optimum for a given turbine inlet temperature. Machines for combined cycles must also keep exhaust temperature above about 600 °C so the steam cycle downstream has high-grade heat, so pressure ratios are chosen around 20 rather than for maximum simple-cycle efficiency. Mentor task: draw the energy and material flow of this unit (inputs, conversions, losses, outputs, boundary), mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by resource, environment or operation, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

quiz.question: 依「壓力比與布雷頓循環」的模型 η = 1 − r^(−(γ−1)/γ)，理想布雷頓循環在給定壓力比下的效率（γ = 1.4）最接近下列何者？
quiz.questionEn: Using the model η = 1 − r^(−(γ−1)/γ) for "Pressure ratio and the Brayton cycle", which value is closest to the ideal Brayton-cycle efficiency at the given pressure ratio (γ = 1.4)?
quiz.explanation: η = 1 − r^(−(γ−1)/γ)；代入 rp = 23，得 59.2 %（理想布雷頓循環在給定壓力比下的效率（γ = 1.4））。 其餘選項是倍數或數量級錯誤。
quiz.explanationEn: η = 1 − r^(−(γ−1)/γ); with rp = 23 the result is 59.2 % (ideal Brayton-cycle efficiency at the given pressure ratio (γ = 1.4)). The other options are factor or order-of-magnitude errors.

steps.title: 壓力比與布雷頓循環：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Pressure ratio and the Brayton cycle: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「壓力比與布雷頓循環」的關鍵量，並判斷輸入改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “Pressure ratio and the Brayton cycle” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：η = 1 − r^(−(γ−1)/γ)；代入 rp = 23，得 59.2 %（理想布雷頓循環在給定壓力比下的效率（γ = 1.4））。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 rp 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: η = 1 − r^(−(γ−1)/γ); with rp = 23 the result is 59.2 % (ideal Brayton-cycle efficiency at the given pressure ratio (γ = 1.4)). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise rp by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：rp 增加 10% 時，結果變為 60.3 %（+1.9%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising rp by 10% changes the result to 60.3 % (+1.9%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。

steps.check: 重現 59.2 %（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 rp 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 59.2 % (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in rp with an engineering explanation.

Under ASME PTC 22 or ISO 2314 measure compressor discharge pressure and temperature, exhaust temperature, fuel flow and output, compute compressor and turbine isentropic efficiency, and compare with the maker's performance curves.

steps.title: 壓力比與布雷頓循環：試驗與驗證

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Pressure ratio and the Brayton cycle” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 依 ASME PTC 22 或 ISO 2314 量測壓縮機出口壓力與溫度、排氣溫度、燃料流量與出力，計算壓縮機與渦輪的等熵效率，與製造商性能曲線比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器、基準或校正、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停留點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Under ASME PTC 22 or ISO 2314 measure compressor discharge pressure and temperature, exhaust temperature, fuel flow and output, compute compressor and turbine isentropic efficiency, and compare with the maker's performance curves. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments, baseline or calibration, procedure, comparison, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：啟停程序要以防喘放氣閥與可調導葉保持喘振裕度，任何改變葉片或流道的修改都須重新確認喘振線。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Start-up and shutdown procedures should keep surge margin with bleed valves and variable guide vanes, and any change to blading or flow path requires reconfirming the surge line.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：壓縮機在低轉速或進氣畸變下發生喘振：氣流瞬間逆流並伴隨巨響，葉片承受劇烈的交變負載，數次喘振就可能造成葉片斷裂。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境與運轉條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: At low speed or with distorted inlet flow a compressor surges: flow reverses momentarily with a loud bang and blades take violent alternating loads, and a few surges can break them. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停留點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格、由誰簽認。
